subject: Need board-export.jsonl + margin columns
body: Gemini: please emit board-export.jsonl to docs/ops/stats-lane/incoming/ (worktree stats-books-ordering-2026-09-18 or main Sports). Required for MIMO-1/2: bookmakerCount, rankingP, rankingSource, marketFairProb, confidence, generatedAt, commenceTime, pickType, sport, result, modelVersion. Additional required for MIMO-3 Jackknife+ margins: actualMargin OR homeScore+awayScore, predictedMeanMargin (or SPREAD line + documented home-margin convention). Column contract: docs/ops/stats-lane/ORDERING_AND_BOOKS_COLUMNS.md. Law 7: agents must not invent DATABASE_URL — founder/ops run is OK.
